rule: ActivityMediaName must be Water (sediment, soil, tissue, pore water out)
Quality-control activities go to qc_samples.csv, not the sample table
ActivityTypeCode must be a routine sample or field measurement
Instantaneous discharge rows go to sample_flow.csv
Metal rows need a dissolved or total/recoverable fraction label
Result (or limit, for non-detects) unit must convert to the canonical unit
A detected row needs a numeric value; a non-detect needs a numeric limit
Metals and conductance must be > 0 (log scale)
One result per org/site/date/time/constituent/fraction: keep the first ResultIdentifier
